title: Personal Credit Cards: how many points are redeemed to restore an overdrawn autopay source, and their cash value
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: sizing the restoring deposit redemption

This rule belongs to the Personal Credit Cards line. Once the card's autopay source checking account is overdrawn and the points needed to bring it back to zero are known, it fixes how many points are actually redeemed as the restoring deposit, and the cash value that deposit delivers.

## Rule

1. The target is the greater of the points needed and the tier's smallest redemption.
2. When the card's unredeemed points are fewer than that target, all unredeemed points are redeemed instead.
3. When the card's unredeemed points are below the tier's smallest redemption, no deposit is made.
4. The cash value delivered is the points redeemed multiplied by the tier's cash value per point, rounded half-up to the cent.

## Order of the comparisons

1. First take the greater of the points needed and the smallest redemption.
2. Then, if the unredeemed points fall short of that figure, use all unredeemed points.
3. In every case, if the unredeemed points are below the smallest redemption, nothing is redeemed.
4. Finally value the points redeemed at the cash value per point and round half-up to the cent.

## Worked examples (hypothetical terms: smallest redemption 1000 points, cash value 0.03 USD per point)

| Points needed | Unredeemed points | Target | Points redeemed | Cash value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1443 | 6600 | 1443 | 1443 | 43.29 USD |
| 300 | 6600 | 1000 | 1000 | 30.00 USD |
| 1443 | 1200 | 1443 | 1200, all of them | 36.00 USD |
| 1443 | 800 | 1443 | none, below the smallest redemption | no deposit |
| 300 | 900 | 1000 | none, below the smallest redemption | no deposit |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- **Wrong:** redeem exactly the points needed even when they are below the smallest redemption. **Correct:** redeem at least the smallest redemption, as the target is the greater of the two.
- **Wrong:** when the card holds fewer points than the target, redeem nothing. **Correct:** redeem all unredeemed points, provided they reach the smallest redemption.
